The '''Deforested Slopes''' was the name given to the northern part of the [[Wooded Valley]] in the [[Apalis Coast]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] after the forces of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] cut down the area's trees. The slopes were located just south of the [[House Organa (estate)|Organa estate]], and were the site of two of the [[Spears of Organa]].<ref name="TOR" />
